column1: # Pantry Recipes ingredient densities. Written for this app (MIT License).
# Classes: flour and baking = dry baking ingredients (shown in grams by the default "weights" setting);
# spice = measured in spoons (kept in tsp/tbsp); liquid = kept in ml/cups; fat, dairy, grain, produce, other =
# converted only by the US/Metric settings and the Conversions screen.
# Values are rounded kitchen averages (spooned and levelled for flours). Real ingredients vary by brand,
# grind and packing, so a kitchen scale is always more accurate.
